name: homemove
description: Homemove, your UK moving assistant in ChatGPT: prices for surveys, valuations, EPCs and safety certificates, conveyancing, removals, man and van and moving cleans, broadband at your new address, stamp duty, a moving checklist, and your whole move planned step by step.

interface.longDescription:
Homemove is your UK moving assistant in ChatGPT. Ask anything about moving home, whether you are buying, selling, renting or letting, and Homemove answers with real prices and next steps, shown with the Homies.

Prices: ask what a survey or valuation, an EPC, a gas safety or electrical certificate, conveyancing, removals or a man and van, an end of tenancy or moving clean, or packing would cost, and Homemove works it out from its own pricing. Pick your home from the address list and it fills in what it can from the property records, such as bedrooms, the value band and freehold or leasehold, so you answer fewer questions.

Your whole move: say whether you are buying, selling, both, renting or letting, and Homemove sets out every step with its quote, plus the stamp duty you would pay to HMRC, shown apart from Homemove's fees. Not sure which survey you need? Homemove explains the difference and quotes the one that fits.

Everything around the move: a checklist of what to do and who to tell, dated from your moving day; the broadband available at your new address from homemove.com's broadband comparison, by speed or monthly cost, with a link to each provider (confirm with the provider before ordering; Homemove may earn a commission); the council tax band of a home; mortgage repayment figures; and the way into homemove.com for home insurance, mortgages and choosing an estate agent.

When you are ready, the card continues to the right page on homemove.com, where you confirm the details and final price.

Limitations: quotes are confirmed when you book on homemove.com. Some combinations, such as very large homes or expert-witness valuations, are quoted by the Homemove team rather than instantly. Homemove does not give mortgage advice, recommend lenders or insurers, or show insurance premiums in ChatGPT; those are handled on homemove.com. Stamp duty covers England and Northern Ireland and mortgage figures are illustrative sums, not advice. Homemove needs no account and takes no payments in ChatGPT.
capabilities: Quotes for surveys, valuations, EPCs and safety certificates from the address
Conveyancing, removals, man and van and moving-clean quotes
Broadband at your new address, stamp duty and council tax band
A moving checklist and your whole move planned step by step
defaultPrompt: How much is a Level 2 survey?
I'm buying my first home in Leeds. What will moving cost?
Who do I need to tell when I move house?

review.commerce_description: Homemove takes no payments and sells nothing in ChatGPT. Quotes need no account; booking happens on homemove.com.

publication.release_notes: Answers every part of a UK move: a moving checklist of who to tell, council tax bands, mortgage repayment figures, broadband at an address, and the way into home insurance, mortgages and estate agents on homemove.com, alongside quotes picked by address.
